channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Clint Capela | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Clint Capela from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Landry Fields on Clint Capela
item.description:
Landry Fields, on 92.9 FM this morning, talking about Clint Capela:

“We’re ramping him back up. At this point, it’s more of a day-to-day thing.”

Landry Fields on Clint Capela, Jan 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Clint Capela, John Collins
item.description:
Antetokounmpo said of Okongwu.

“Capela is another one. Collins, another one. But I always love playing against people that take pride in defending and take the challenge. You can kind of feel that. I have played against people that you kind of know that they’re not taking this too serious and they kind of have that fear factor in their mind and you can kind of see it in their eyes, kind of smell it from the first play.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Clint Capela, John Collins, Nov 9, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Clint Capela
item.description:
Chris Kirschner:Nate McMillan on Clint Capela's first game back out of protocols:

“I thought it wasn't bad. Conditioning, I thought it would be worse than what it was. He was OK, as far as conditioning-wise. He hasn't played a lot of minutes with Delon. I thought he was OK.”

Nate McMillan on Clint Capela, Dec 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Clint Capela
item.description:
Nate McMillan on getting Clint Capela back for the Christmas Day game vs. the Knicks:

“It's huge. To get a guy back in rotation, it's really important. Especially a big, losing Onyeka, we were down to really one big with John possibly having to play more C position.”

Nate McMillan on Clint Capela, Dec 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Clint Capela
item.description:
Derrick Rose on Clint Capela:

“I'm 32 years old. I never talked shit in my life. I'm not going to start now that Clint Capela said something.”

Derrick Rose on Clint Capela, Jun 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Clint Capela
item.description:
Derrick Rose on Clint Capela:

“You want me to say something about that? ....I’m not going to say anything.”

Derrick Rose on Clint Capela, Jun 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Monty Williams on Clint Capela
item.description:
Suns coachMonty Williams on Hawks center Clint Capela:

“Clint Capela has been one of the best players in the league. Doesn't get a lot of recognition in that category,but he's as important to this team as anybody in the league is to their team.”

Monty Williams on Clint Capela, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on Clint Capela
item.description:
Chris Kirschner:Bogdan Bogdanovic on Clint Capela:

“I feel like he's so disrespected in the league. They don't even know how good he is because he doesn't, maybe, look nice on TV. Maybe he doesn't have highlight moves, but he's really nice.”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on Clint Capela, Apr 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.

item.title: Onyeka Okongwu on Clint Capela
item.description:
Rookie Onyeka Okongwu on Clint Capela:

“Literally today, I asked Clint how he gets all those rebounds he gets. There's players who are taller than him, but he manages to snag 20 boards every other game. I told him, I'm amazed.”

Onyeka Okongwu on Clint Capela, Apr 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on Clint Capela
item.description:
Bogdanovic, on the early stages of free agency.

“I honestly forgot Clint (Capela) was on the roster... Our team is a really, really good team.”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on Clint Capela, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Cameron Reddish on Clint Capela
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Cam Reddish on playing in camp with Clint Capela:

“He's non-stop. He has a tremendous motor. You can always hear him talking.”

Cameron Reddish on Clint Capela, Sep 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: John Collins on Clint Capela
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:John Collins on Clint Capela:

“I've never really played with someone who can attack the glass like I can.”

John Collins on Clint Capela, Sep 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Kevin Huerter on Dewayne Dedmon, Clint Capela
item.description:
“That starts with Clint (Capela), getting Dewayne (Dedmon) back. Really just having a full team. Moving forward, I’d imagine we’re going to sign guys (too)... I think we’re really just excited to put together a full team moving forward that’s now been together a couple years and wants to remove the ‘young’ label and wants to win.”

Kevin Huerter on Dewayne Dedmon, Clint Capela, Jun 15, 2020. Source: Peachtree Hoops.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela:

“His foot's feeling fine. He’s got his strength back. If we're able to have some sort of competition this summer, whether it’s official or unofficial scrimmages, it would be great to get him on the court with our guys and just start that process.”

Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela, Jun 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Cameron Reddish on Clint Capela
item.description:
“We have all the pieces that it takes to be a really good team in the NBA. Obviously with Trae being Trae, we have good size all around, and I think adding (center Clint Capela) into the lineup is going to help a lot. Obviously added some veteran guys to us, so that always helps. I think next year’s going to be a really good year for us, and I’m looking forward to it.”

Cameron Reddish on Clint Capela, May 31, 2020. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela, John Collins
item.description:
“The first half of the season, when you think about the roster we had, just all the injuries on top of the suspension (of John Collins) and the second half of the season, once we kind of got past the injuries, past the suspension and we made the trade for Clint (Capela), we never had the opportunity to see him,”

Travis Schlenk on Clint Capela, John Collins, Apr 14, 2020. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Clint Capela
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“We actually thought it would work with Capela and it was working. It just wasn't working good enough to win the championship. So once we saw how that didn't work, then we thought we had to make another move.”

Daryl Morey on Clint Capela, Mar 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Trae Young on Clint Capela
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:And this from Trae Young on Capela:

“If you are teammate of his and you are not (chomping at the bit), I don’t know if you are really a good teammate. We are all excited. We really want him back as soon as possible but we also want him to be super healthy.”

Trae Young on Clint Capela, Feb 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.

item.title: James Harden on Clint Capela
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:James Harden on rebounding difference in first and second half:

“...I think we're so comfortable, especially when Clint (Capela) is out there that he's going to get the majority of the rebounds. When we're small we have to actually find a body and team rebound.”

James Harden on Clint Capela, Feb 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela
item.description:
Salman Ali:D'Antoni on Capela (continued):

“Every year he's improved and I expect him to do the same thing this year. He had great work with his national team. He's come in ready to roll. Barring unforseen circumstances, he's going to be great [this season].”

Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela, Sep 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on the backlash Clint Capela caught this summer:

“I think people overreact. That's what I think... Clint was really good all year... He has one bad series and all of a sudden the guy can't play? I mean, come on. That's what drives me crazy.”

Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela, Jul 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela
item.description:
Ben DuBose:More D'Antoni:

“James gets better every year. Hopefully that'll just continue. Clint [Capela] will get a lot better. Eric is good, and PJ... we've got a nice base. Daryl does a great job of getting other pieces that'll fit in. But we have enough.”

Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela, May 16, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni:

“It was teetering. It was teetering. I mean you’re 11-14 (on Dec. 8), and at 25 games everybody usually says you can tell what kind of team you have – and we’re 11-14.And we hadn’t sustained Clint (Capela) missing 15 (games from mid-January to mid-February) and CP missing (17 from mid-December to late January) after that, so for me – and you can write it – that’s why James is the MVP.I’m telling you, he took that, and without CP, without Clint, with us changing almost half the roster, and took us where we have a chance to be third. Nobody else could do that. I’m telling you right now. Nobody.”

Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela, Apr 3, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: James Harden on Chris Paul, Clint Capela
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:James Harden:

“Things change when those guys (Paul and Capela) are out of the lineup. When they're in, everybody has their roles and everybody contributes. So the more guys that out, the more pressure it puts on the guys that are actually playing. Full roster is better for us.”

James Harden on Chris Paul, Clint Capela, Feb 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Clint Capela
item.description:
Salman Ali:Eric Gordon:

“Our future's bright right now. Once we get Clint (Capela) back, we're going to have a really deep team.”

Eric Gordon on Clint Capela, Jan 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Steven Adams on Clint Capela
item.description:
Salman Ali:Steven Adams on Clint Capela:

“He's a very good system player and plays very well, and knows his spots, and they find him really well. He's a great rebounder in general.”

Steven Adams on Clint Capela, Dec 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: LeBron James on Clint Capela
item.description:
LeBron James on Clint Capela:

“He's improved every year since he's come into the league. He's always one of the league leaders in field goal percentage. His ability to catch lobs, his ability to run the floor & his ability to change shots defensively makes him dynamic.”

LeBron James on Clint Capela, Dec 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela:

“I talked to him yesterday. Really happy for him. I said just remember three years ago you were at Rio Grande sitting on the bench couldn't make a foul shot... He's gotten to the point where he's one of the best centers, if not the best in the league.”

Mike D'Antoni on Clint Capela, Jul 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: James Harden on Clint Capela
item.description:
Rockets’James Harden on Clint Capela’s new deal:

“Obviously we love the game of basketball but to be able to provide for your family for generations, that’s what we do it for. I’ve seen him work his butt off these last few years. He listens, learns, competes. I’m happy for him.”

James Harden on Clint Capela, Jul 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Clint Capela
item.description:
Logan Murdock:Kevin Durant on Clint Capela saying Houston is a better team than the Warriors:

“You hear that from guys like Capela, who’s usually catching the ball or laying it up from CP or Harden. His job is not as hard. I mean when your job is that hard you don’t say shit like that.”

Kevin Durant on Clint Capela, Jan 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @loganmmurdock.
